title: Game prototype, any suggestions?
author: Obi_745
selftext:
Just a random shooter I've made using Three.js. Thinking if I should add multiplayer. Let me know if you have any suggestions, ideas, or feedback. Thanks.

  
P.S. Since this is r/aigamedev I suppose I can add the fact that the game was made fully with an AI agent (I have my own custom-made agent, the model is 4-bit quantized Gemma 4 31B), fully linguistic feedback loop, no manual code editing at any stage.

comments.author: kal101246
comments.body: What makes your game unique to the other? What's your pitch and core gameplay loop? Currently the game is of course a demo but think of that as it would need to grab attention and cause someone to want to play the game.

replies.author: Obi_745
replies.body: I was thinking adding multiplayer next. I'm not yet sure if I want to make a simple multiplayer shooter, or go for more open-world aspect.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: I mean good progress to start but it's literally a flat plane with a black void sky and I think the only asset is a gun mesh? There's nothing to comment on because there isn't anything here

replies.author: Obi_745
replies.body: Do you want to see anything cool in the game? You can leave a prompt like "Add flying enemies" and I will show the result of that prompt in the next post, you can basically request anything. Sort of like "community-prompted" game.

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body: So you want to be a middle man between me and the ai you are using to make your skeleton of an fps? No thanks man I'm good.

replies.author: Rofl_Raptor
replies.body: Just stop. This isn't a passion for you. This is something you did in some minutes of boredom.

comments.author: Ir0nh34d
comments.body: You have an FPS and wave shooter set of mechanics and nothing else. There is no "game" here.

replies.author: Obi_745
replies.body: What would make it a "game" though?

replies.author: PuteMorte
replies.body: There is no difference between asking for advice before you had AI oneshot this basic 3D ballshooting demo or after. You don't have something to make better, you have something anyone can do in UE in 5 minutes. It's the equivalent of drawing 2 sticks figures in paint and asking "how can I make my drawing better?"

replies.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
replies.body: What makes you want to keep playing is the difference between a prototype and a game

comments.author: AutomaticTalent
comments.body:
Start with some game play - then add on the graphics and audio.  You can't frost a turd - it will always be a turd when you get down to it.

Find your game seed and something that's fun to do 1000 times over will usually give insight what to do next.  Something original, hopefully.

comments.author: darknessinducedlove
comments.body: Honestly its a solid baseline to craft something. Hit me up and we could bounce off each other.

comments.author: AlmostLiminal
comments.body: My suggestion: make something unique that isn't trivial to make in 5 minutes with or without AI before you fucking post again.

comments.author: LastDevelopment4153
comments.body: Maybe animals or zombies would work better than boxes.It would feel more like combat and make players more invested in the fight.
